source.name: Theorems about the definitions of the features of a series against itself at every lag, checked by Lean
source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/Lags.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_lags.py and checked by Lean's kernel

tolerance.reason: no rounding: every value is a multiple of 1/4, so each product and each addition is exact, and the division by 8 gives the quotient itself, which is a double; the expected value is exact

42 roundings, each within 2^-53 relatively: the product in every term and at most N - 1 additions, in a sum whose magnitudes are at most those of the sum at lag zero, which gives the largest result; the division; and the expected value
